Subject: VPC pricing inquiry: 3 envs + SLA needs

Alex —

Thanks for the demo last week. SaaSHealth is evaluating a VPC/private deployment to support our next phase (staging, production, DR) and we need a clear cost + support picture to move procurement. A few specific asks:

- Pricing for a three-environment private deployment (single-region initially) including any license model options (subscription vs perpetual) and recommended SKU mix.
- How the platform fee is normally structured for customers on multi-environment setups — can that be amortized or credited against committed spend?
- Support tiers and what’s included in 24x7 on-call vs business hours — we have strict SLA requirements for production incidents.
- Any migration/onboarding concessions for a 12-month commitment or reserved capacity?

We want to present a two-slide summary to our CPO/Procurement by next Wednesday (5/19). Can you provide a written commercial that covers the above + a draft SOW we can share with procurement?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Platform Engineering, SaaSHealth

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear list. I attached a concise pricing matrix (RI_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx) that lays out three options: subscription (annual), term-based perpetual with annual support, and committed reserved capacity (GPU-hours). Highlights:

- Platform fee: default is an annual platform fee that covers control-plane, updates, and base observability. We can amortize the platform fee across the 12-month term for committed deals (common approach).
- Migration/onboarding credit: typical range is 10–25% of the first-year platform fee depending on commit size and reserved capacity.
- Support: Standard (business hours M–F), Premium (24x7 on-call + 1-hour P1 response target) available as an add-on. Premium includes 2 named on-call engineers and quarterly runbooks. See SLA grid in the next attachment if helpful.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll run numbers with Monica (pricing) and Vivek (CS/Onboarding) for a formal written commercial.
2) We can include a draft SOW for procurement to accelerate.

I’ll aim to get a revised commercial by EOD Wed (5/13) so you have time for CPO review.

Best,
Alex Martinez

Alex —

Internal calc notes for HS-2048:
- Base platform fee (annual) for single-region, 3-env bundle: $180k/yr.
- If customer commits to 12 months + reserved capacity (equiv. to 4x p4d slots), we can offer: 20% migration credit off first-year platform fee OR a 3-month platform fee waiver (which is slightly more expensive for us in $ but cleaner in procurement).
- Support tiers: premium SLA (24x7 with 1-hr P1) priced at +$60k/yr; includes on-call rotations and escalation path via Vivek’s team.
- Discounting levers: upfront payment, reserved GPU commit, case studies/reference, multi-year commitment.

Recommendation: Offer a headline commercial with two paths so procurement has options: (A) 15% migration credit + 10% volume discount vs (B) 3-month platform fee waiver + 7% volume discount. Prefer A if commit includes reserved capacity. Also push for SOW to include a defined onboarding milestone cadence to limit professional services overspend.

I’ll produce a short worksheet with both options and the net ARR impact by EOD.

Monica
Director, Pricing & Packaging

Jordan —

Following up with a formal commercial and an option set so procurement can choose the contracting path that suits internal policies. Attached: SLA_grid.pdf and the updated RI_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx. Summary below (headline numbers):

Option A (Reserved + Credit) — recommended
- Structure: 12-month subscription + reserved capacity (equiv. 4x p4d slots)
- Platform fee: $180,000/yr (amortized monthly)
- Migration credit: 15% off first-year platform fee (applies as credit on month 1 invoice)
- Volume discount: 10% on per-token usage for committed GPU hours
- Support: Premium SLA (24x7) available at +$60,000/yr
- Onboarding: estimated 6 weeks, success milestones included in SOW

Option B (Waiver + Lower Commit) — procurement-friendly
- Structure: 12-month subscription without reserved capacity
- Platform fee: $180,000/yr with 3-month platform fee waiver applied at contract start
- Migration credit: none
- Volume discount: 7% on usage
- Support: Premium SLA at +$75,000/yr if purchased standalone (higher because we keep more CS buffer)

We can flex the migration credit up to 20% for a multi-year commit or notable case study agreement. Please note the premium SLA price varies if you require an SLA with financial credits; we’ll need legal to approve any SLA-backed SLOs with service credits.

Attached is a draft SOW (Docusign_SOW.pdf) that outlines deliverables, onboarding milestones, and acceptance criteria. If this looks correct I can issue a DocuSign envelope for signature and loop procurement for billing terms.
